title: Getting young minds into design ｜ 让年轻人走进设计

sents.en: Recently, a leading design federation in the UK warned that the UK could face a creative skills shortage, after the latest figures revealed a drop of almost 10 percent in students studying Design and Technology.
sents.cn: 最近，英国一家领先的设计联合会警告称，随着最新数据显示修读“设计与技术”课程的学生人数下降了近10%，英国可能面临创意技能短缺。

sents.en: These figures showed that the number of pupils that sat exams in Design and Technology fell 10 percent from 204,788 to 185,279 last year.
sents.cn: 这些数据显示，去年参加“设计与技术”考试的学生人数从204,788降至185,279，降幅达10%。

sents.en: Chief executive John Kampfner of the Creative Industries Federation thinks that this drop in figures has worrying implications for the skills pipeline in Britain·s hugely successful arts and creative industries.
sents.cn: 创意产业联合会首席执行官约翰∙坎普夫纳认为，这一数字下降对英国极为成功的艺术与创意产业的人才输送造成令人担忧的影响。

sents.en: He said, ·We already have skills shortages in many jobs such as animation (动画制作) and special effects.” He added: “Engineering, which requires a similar mix of creative and technical skills, also has recruitment problems.·
sents.cn: 他说：“我们在动画制作（动画制作）和特效等许多岗位上已经出现技能短缺。”他补充道：“工程领域同样需要创意与技术技能的混合，也面临招聘难题。”

sents.en: Many other designers and architects have expressed concern over the future supply of home-grown talent for UK firms, and industry bodies have pointed out that there has been a lack of roots-level support.
sents.cn: 许多其他设计师和建筑师对英国企业未来本土人才的供给表示担忧，行业机构也指出缺乏根基层面的支持。

sents.en: However, if these designers had visited the Design Museum shop in London earlier this year their fears may have been eased.
sents.cn: 然而，如果这些设计师今年早些时候去过伦敦的设计博物馆商店，他们的担忧或许会有所缓解。

sents.en: With £10 to spend, they could have bought a fascinating children·s toy called ·Dazzle Racer·.
sents.cn: 花10英镑，他们本可以买到一款引人入胜的儿童玩具，名为“DazzleRacer”。

sents.en: An automotive cylinder(圆柱体), it included a wind-up, elastic (有弹性的)-band-powered mechanism, minimal parts, all 100 percent recycled and lots of stickers.
sents.cn: 它是一个汽车圆柱体（圆柱体），包含一个上发条、橡皮筋（有弹性的）驱动的装置，零件极简，百分之百可回收，还配有许多贴纸。

sents.en: It was good fun, simple, eye-catching and very original.
sents.cn: 它好玩、简单、引人注目，且极具创意。

sents.en: Well you·d expect the Design Museum to commission and make some interesting items, but this one was different.
sents.cn: 你大概会想到设计博物馆委托并制作一些有趣的物品，但这一件与众不同。

sents.en: Designed by a group of six Year 9 and Year 10 boys from Finchley Catholic High School, the toy was the winning entry in the museum·s 2015 Design Ventura competition, which brings the business of design to life for students aged 13 to 16 by challenging them to develop a new creative, sustainable and commercially feasible product for the Design Museum shop and attracts hundreds of entries nationwide.
sents.cn: 这款玩具由芬奇利天主高中六名九年级和十年级男生设计，是博物馆2015年DesignVentura竞赛的获奖作品；该竞赛要求学生（13至16岁）为设计博物馆商店开发一款富有创意、可持续且具商业可行性的新产品，从而让设计生意鲜活起来，并吸引了全国数百份参赛作品。

sents.en: ·We did Design Ventura in my previous school,· says Liam Hourican, Finchley Catholic High School·s design technology curriculum leader.
sents.cn: “我在之前的学校就做过DesignVentura，”芬奇利天主高中设计与技术课程负责人利亚姆∙霍里坎说，“四年前我换学校时，就把这个项目带了过来，因为它有助于培养如此多的技能。

sents.en: ·Then when I changed schools four years ago, I introduced it here because it helps to develop so many skills.·
The theme for last year·s competition was ·Move·, and Hourican began with three groups working in lunch breaks and after school before selecting the group with the most innovative idea.
sents.cn: 去年的竞赛主题是“Move”，霍里坎起初带领三个小组利用午休和课后时间工作，然后选出最具创意想法的小组。

sents.en: Each participating school may submit just one proposal.
sents.cn: 每所参赛学校只能提交一份方案。

sents.en: ·It·s the taking part and doing the work which is important,· he says.
sents.cn: “重要的是参与和付出努力，”他说，“我从没梦想过我们会赢。

sents.en: ·And I never dreamt we·d win.·

Catherine Ritman Smith, head of learning at the Design Museum, is expecting around 10,000 participants aged 13 to 16 to take part this year and says that the project · funded by Deutsche Bank as part of its youth engagement programme Born To Be · is the biggest event in the museum·s calendar.
sents.cn: 设计博物馆学习主管凯瑟琳∙里特曼∙史密斯预计今年约有10,000名13至16岁的参与者加入，并表示该项目——由德意志银行通过其青年参与计划“生而为赢”（BornToBe）资助——是博物馆日程中最大的活动。

sents.en: ·We started Design Ventura with around 800 young people in 2010 and it has grown steadily since,· she says.
sents.cn: “我们2010年以约800名年轻人启动DesignVentura，此后稳步发展，”她说。

sents.en: ·Teachers like it because the skills are all transferable and it helps to validate the value of design as a subject,· she explains, telling me that nearly 600 schools have taken part so far.
sents.cn: “教师喜欢它，因为这些技能都可迁移，并有助于证实设计作为一门学科的价值，”她解释道，并告诉我迄今已有近600所学校参与。

sents.en: So how does the competition work?
sents.cn: 那么竞赛是如何运作的？

sents.en: A single-word theme is announced in the summer.
sents.cn: 夏季会公布一个单字主题。

sents.en: This year it is ·Change·.
sents.cn: 今年的主题是“Change”（改变）。

sents.en: Schools work with groups to produce imaginative design ideas for a product in simple materials that could sell for £10 in the Design Museum Shop.
sents.cn: 学校与小组合作，用简单材料为可在设计博物馆商店以10英镑出售的产品构思富有想象力的设计创意。

sents.en: Participating schools then register by November and eventually submit their design idea.
sents.cn: 参赛学校随后在11月前注册，并最终提交设计方案。

sents.en: Along the way there is training and support for teachers and tutoring for students from designers.
sents.cn: 在此过程中，教师会得到培训与支持，学生则获得设计师的辅导。

sents.en: An additional bonus is when the winners see their design on sale in the spring of the following year.
sents.cn: 额外的惊喜是，获奖者能在次年春天看到自己的设计上市销售。

sents.en: Hourican and his pupils have happy memories of spending a whole day at the museum, having been selected as one of 10 shortlisted schools to present their idea to a panel of judges, including designer Jasper Conran.
sents.cn: 霍里坎和他的学生们有着愉快的回忆：他们被选为10所入围学校之一，在博物馆度过整整一天，向包括设计师贾斯珀∙康兰在内的评审团展示想法。

sents.en: Then they worked with the Kin Design Studio in Shoreditch, met designers at their school and attended a lunch with Deutsche Bank employees.
sents.cn: 随后他们与肖尔迪奇的Kin设计工作室合作，在学校与设计师会面，并参加了与德意志银行员工的午餐会。

sents.en: The students helped to make decisions and there were plenty of discussions · they changed the product·s name, for example.
sents.cn: 学生们参与决策，进行了大量讨论——例如，他们更改了产品的名称。

sents.en: ·One of the really useful things about this competition,· says Hourican, ·is that there·s a commercial element because the product is going on sale for real and the boys had to learn about budgeting and marketing, as well as designing their game.· Profits go to charity.
sents.cn: “这项竞赛真正有用的地方之一，”霍里坎说，“在于它有商业元素，因为产品真的会上架销售，男孩们必须学习预算和营销，以及游戏设计。

sents.en: ·The winning team chooses where it wants the profits to go,· says Ritman Smith.
sents.cn: ”利润捐给慈善机构。

sents.en: ·The Finchley Catholic High School product raised about £1,000 for Great Ormond Street Hospital.· Winning entries in past years have included a make-your-own cloth kit called Dove Bunting and a threefold, wallet-sized travel game with goals at each end, called Badoiiing.
sents.cn: “获奖团队可自行选择利润的去向，”里特曼∙史密斯说，“芬奇利天主高中的产品为大奥蒙德街医院筹得约1,000英镑。

sents.en: Badoiiing。
sents.cn: ”往年的获奖作品包括一个名为DoveBunting的自制布料套装，以及一个可三折、如钱包大小、两端设球门的旅行游戏

sents.en: It costs the schools nothing to participate in Design Ventura; the professional designers provide their services for free.
sents.cn: 学校参与DesignVentura无需支付任何费用；专业设计师免费提供服务。

sents.en: Among them are architect Asif Khan, a Design Museum trustee who has worked as designer-in-residence at the museum, helping emerging architects.
sents.cn: 其中包括建筑师阿西夫∙汗，他是设计博物馆的受托人，曾担任该馆驻馆设计师，帮助新兴建筑师。

sents.en: He has recently been commissioned to design the new Museum of London building in Smithfield.
sents.cn: 他最近受委托设计位于史密斯菲尔德的新伦敦博物馆大楼。

sents.en: Another is television presenter and interior designer Naomi Cleaver, who is one of the competition·s judges.
sents.cn: 另一位是电视节目主持人和室内设计师娜奥米∙克利弗，她也是竞赛评委之一。

sents.en: ·I'm very keen to encourage young people,· she says, observing that design brings together other subjects such as literature, art, history, geography and science.
sents.cn: “我非常热衷于鼓励年轻人，”她说，并指出设计将文学、艺术、历史、地理和科学等其他学科联系在一起。

sents.en: ·Now that design education is limited in the curriculum, I·m all in favour of competitions such as Design Ventura, which helps to bring the standard curriculum to life,· says Cleaver.
sents.cn: “如今设计教育在课程中受到限制，我完全支持像DesignVentura这样的竞赛，它有助于让标准课程生动起来，”克利弗说。

sents.en: ·And the judging day is terrific fun.
sents.cn: “评审日非常有趣。

sents.en: Some of these students are very imaginative.
sents.cn: 这些学生中有些极富想象力。

sents.en: One group presented their idea in the form of a puppet show and we see some marvelous demonstration models.
sents.cn: 有一组以木偶戏的形式展示想法，我们还看到了一些精彩的演示模型。

sents.en: ·I·m always impressed by the levels of confidence and the support the students get from their teachers.··
sents.cn: ”学生们展现出的自信以及他们从老师那里得到的支持，总是让我印象深刻。“”

sents.en: Ritman Smith adds: ·Design technology has become a tricky subject to make a case for, and we·ve heard of departments closing in some schools.
sents.cn: 里特曼∙史密斯补充道：“设计与技术已成为一门难以证明其价值的学科，我们听说一些学校的该部门正在关闭。

sents.en: We find that if pupils take part in Design Ventura in Year Nine it can be the trigger which leads them to opt for it at General Certificate of Secondary Education, so we are helping to keep alive something which is crucial to industry and entrepreneurship.·
sents.cn: 我们发现，如果九年级学生参与DesignVentura，可能会成为触发他们选择该学科参加中等教育普通证书（GCSE）考试的因素，因此我们是在帮助维系对工业和创业至关重要的这门学科。”
